_comment: Events for What's On and the Today board. TWO SEPARATE LISTS. `items` are dated one-off events, filtered by `upcoming` and `todayOnly`. `regulars` are things that happen every week — classes, clubs, markets, groups — which are fixtures rather than events: they are NOT expanded into dated occurrences and never appear in the upcoming list, because twelve copies of a yoga class would bury the actual events. They render as their own section grouped by day, and surface on the Today board on the matching weekday. LISTING RULE: anything open to the public in Largs may be listed, free, on the same terms and in the same format. No paid placement, no editorial favour, no ranking. A yoga class, a church coffee morning and a pub quiz get identical treatment. This is what makes it possible to list a friend's class without it being a favour — and what keeps free listings free if paid enhancements are ever added elsewhere on the site.
_regularsFields: title (REQUIRED — the template prints it with no fallback, so a listing without one renders headless; this was missing from the list until 31 Aug 2026 and the first regular was written without a title because of it) · weekday (lowercase name, required) · time · venue · blurb · contact (either plain text — a phone number, 'ask at the counter' — or {label, url} for a link, the same shape the directory uses for social links; a bare URL as plain text prints as a raw address) · image (optional, a site-relative path like /assets/img/ev-thing.png — rendered in the same fixed 200px SQUARE box a dated event's image gets, cropped to fill, so prepare it square) — plus three fields that stop a listing quietly rotting: `from` and `until` bound the term (most classes stop for the school holidays, and without these you would be advertising a class that is not running), and `except` lists one-off cancellations as ISO dates. All three optional; omit `until` for something that runs indefinitely.

items.title: Largs Viking Festival
items.blurb: The Viking Village returns to the seafront, 10:00–17:00 daily, building to the Festival of Fire.

items.title: Cumbrae to Largs charity swim
items.blurb: Swimmers cross the 1.7-mile channel from Cumbrae to Largs in aid of Race Against Dementia — a swim John Burleigh has organised since 2006. Registration at Cairnie's Quay from 11:00, then the 12:30 ferry over; the swim starts at 13:00 from the old Cumbrae Watersports Centre and everyone is out of the water by 15:00. Free to watch from the shore.
